failed_execution.failed_step: Execute JANUS-selected value-blind earliest six-channel gate
failed_execution.note: The original implementation submitted a full logical year of one-second six-channel selectors in one HTTP POST. EarthScope timed out before a result receipt existed.

transport_only_repair.repair: Partition each logical year into deterministic chronological calendar-month transport chunks. Complete each chunk before advancing. Do not skip a failed chunk. Choose the first all-six date only after every earlier chunk has been successfully classified from headers/no-data transport state.
transport_only_repair.reason: Reduce server-side request size and read-timeout risk without changing which dates are eligible or how the earliest date is selected.
